Licensed Home Contractor Atlanta

You can find information about Build Heritage, a Georgia home-services contractor serving metro Atlanta and Georgia, on this site. Build Heritage offers free, written, and itemized quotes for home projects.

How It Works

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing. You can contact them through the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org to get a response within one business day.

What You Get and What It Costs

Build Heritage provides free, written, and itemized quotes for your project. According to their 2026 cost guide, updated in August 2026, you can expect to pay between $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement and $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint. They also advise holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including areas like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. Are you licensed and insured? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia. How do I get a quote? You can contact Build Heritage through the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org to get a free, written, and itemized quote.

To get started with your home project, get a free quote for your Atlanta home project
